commands.cmd:
p=$(command -v context-mode) || { echo "CONTEXT_MODE_RESOLVE_FAIL: context-mode not on PATH"; exit 1; }
rp=$(readlink -f "$p") || { echo "CONTEXT_MODE_RESOLVE_FAIL: unresolvable $p"; exit 1; }
case "$rp" in */tools/context-mode-1.0.169/*) : ;; *) echo "CONTEXT_MODE_RESOLVE_FAIL: unexpected prefix $rp"; exit 1 ;; esac
ap=$(python3 -c "import json;print([t['version'] for t in json.load(open('adoption/pins-linux-x86_64.json'))['tools'] if t['id']=='context-mode'][0])") || exit 1
sv=$(python3 -c "import json;print([x['version'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id']=='context-mode'][0])") || exit 1
wp=$(python3 -c "import json,glob;print(sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers',[]) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id')=='context-mode'}))") || exit 1
if [ "$ap" = "1.0.169" ] && [ "$sv" = "1.0.169" ] && [ "$wp" = "[]" ]; then
  echo "CONTEXT_MODE_RESOLVE_OK | resolves: $p -> $rp | adoption pin: $ap | stack pin: $sv | landscape winner pins: $wp"
else
  echo "CONTEXT_MODE_RESOLVE_FAIL | adoption pin: $ap | stack pin: $sv | landscape winner pins: $wp"
  exit 1
fi

commands.cmd:
PREFIX="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/tools/context-mode-1.0.169"
PKGJSON="$PREFIX/lib/node_modules/context-mode/package.json"
TARBALL="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/downloads/context-mode-1.0.169.tgz"
nls=$(timeout 30 npm ls --global --prefix "$PREFIX" --depth=0 2>&1) || { echo "CONTEXT_MODE_PACKAGE_FAIL: npm ls failed"; exit 1; }
python3 - "$PKGJSON" "$TARBALL" "$nls" <<'PY'
import hashlib, io, json, sys, tarfile
pkgjson, tarball, nls = sys.argv[1:4]
pin = [t for t in json.load(open('adoption/pins-linux-x86_64.json'))['tools'] if t['id'] == 'context-mode'][0]
data = open(tarball, 'rb').read()
tar_sha = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
member = tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(data)).extractfile('package/package.json').read()
installed = open(pkgjson, 'rb').read()
version = json.loads(installed)['version']
ok = version == pin['version'] == '1.0.169' and tar_sha == pin['sha256'] and member == installed and 'context-mode@1.0.169' in nls
print('CONTEXT_MODE_PACKAGE_' + ('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'), '| installed package.json version', version, '| downloads/context-mode-1.0.169.tgz sha256 equals the adoption pin sha256:', tar_sha == pin['sha256'], '| tarball package/package.json byte-identical to the installed one:', member == installed, '| npm ls: context-mode@1.0.169', 'context-mode@1.0.169' in nls)
print('tarball sha256', tar_sha, '| pin url', pin['url'])
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY

commands.cmd:
P="$HOME/.claude/plugins/cache/context-mode/context-mode/1.0.169"
rev=$(sed -n 's/.*mksglu\/context-mode --ref \([0-9a-f]\{40\}\).*/\1/p' recipes/README.md | head -1)
python3 - "$P" "$rev" <<'PY'
import json, os, sys
p, rev = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
plugin = json.load(open(os.path.join(p, '.claude-plugin', 'plugin.json')))
entries = json.load(open(os.path.expanduser('~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json')))['plugins'].get('context-mode@context-mode', [])
match = [e for e in entries if e.get('installPath') == p]
ok = bool(rev) and bool(match) and plugin.get('version') == '1.0.169' and match[0].get('version') == '1.0.169' and match[0].get('gitCommitSha') == rev
print('CONTEXT_MODE_PLUGIN_' + ('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'), '| plugin.json version', plugin.get('version'), '| installed_plugins.json version', match[0].get('version') if match else None, 'gitCommitSha', match[0].get('gitCommitSha') if match else None, '| recipes/README.md reviewed ref', rev)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY
